items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: you know I joined Benny Goodman after Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: So it’s funny how things in your childhood will work. The fact that you got a little experience on that xylophone really paid off later on.
Yeah. Real big. And about the big band, you know I joined Benny Goodman after Louis Armstrong. And we were the first integrated group, the first black and white group.
Was that ever a problem playing in certain parts of the country?
